name: andrho-sites
description: AndRho client websites on Railway (Clients project): SITE_MODE=router is sites-router, which owns *.web.andrho.com and forwards each host to its client's service over the private network; SITE_MODE=site is each client's service (site-<account_id>) with its own SEO. The React + Vite + Tailwind app in src/ is also the template Creators start from.
